text.The Incinerator:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, scrap up to two cards in your hand and/or discard pile. If you have another Machine Cult card in play, you gain 2 Combat for each card scrapped from your hand and/or discard pile this turn. This does not include any cards that are played first and then scrap themselves. The Incinerator is an Outpost with a defense of 6. 
 Strategy ==
Scrapping two cards is obviously great, and it has a strong defense of 6. The ally ability is solid, but unfortunately self-scrapping cards do not count here. Although it is usually considered inferior to Brain World in the base game, there is an exception: if you double this card with a Stealth Tower, you can scrap 4 cards and gain a total of 16 Combat, plus 4 additional Combat for any other card you scrapped! This combination can be an absolute game changer.
